name: Kidney Stones
shortDescription: Kidney stones can cause sudden, severe pain and require timely evaluation and intervention. RoMIUS Urology provides rapid access to care across multiple emergency departments and uses an advanced triage system to ensure patients are evaluated quickly, treated appropriately, and supported throughout every stage of their stone episode. Whether working through a trial of passage or needing urgent surgical intervention, our team offers expert, personalized, and compassionate care.
body:
‍Timely Evaluation & Rapid Access

Kidney stone pain is unpredictable, and delays in care can lead to complications. RoMIUS Urology maintains direct coverage at multiple emergency departments across Northwest and West Central Ohio, ensuring rapid diagnosis and smoother transitions to definitive treatment.

Our advanced triage system prioritizes patients based on symptoms, infection risk, imaging findings, and obstruction severity—allowing us to expedite evaluation, coordinate immediate surgery when needed, and prevent ER delays.

Tailored Treatment Plans

Every kidney stone is different, and so is every patient. We guide individuals through the decision-making process, helping them choose between:

  • Trial of passage
  • Ureteroscopy
  • Extracorporeal Shock Wave Lithotripsy (ESWL)
  • Percutaneous Nephrolithotomy (PCNL) for large or complex stones

We support patients attempting to pass their stone safely at home and provide immediate access to intervention if pain becomes uncontrolled, infection develops, or the trial of passage becomes unsafe or unsuccessful. Our goal is to balance safety, speed, comfort, and patient preference.

Stent Management & Symptom Support

Following stone surgery, some patients require a temporary ureteral stent to ensure safe drainage of the kidney. Stents can cause discomfort, urinary urgency, frequency, or flank pain.

RoMIUS Urology provides comprehensive stent management, including:

  • Medications to control bladder spasms and stent discomfort
  • Pain control strategies tailored to each patient
  • Guidance on activity, hydration, and symptom triggers
  • Rapid access for questions and concerns
  • Timely scheduling for stent removal or exchange

Our team ensures patients feel supported throughout the recovery process, minimizing discomfort and helping them return to normal activity quickly and safely.

Advanced Surgical Expertise

RoMIUS Urology is home to the most experienced stone surgeons in the region, performing high volumes of ureteroscopy, ESWL, and PCNL with excellent outcomes.
Using high-powered lasers, modern digital endoscopes, and advanced imaging, we manage everything from small ureteral stones to large staghorn calculi with precision and efficiency.

Our experience translates directly into safer procedures, faster recovery, and better long-term results for our patients.

Prevention & Long-Term Management

Because kidney stones often recur, RoMIUS Urology focuses heavily on prevention. We provide:

  • Comprehensive metabolic evaluation
  • 24-hour urine analysis
  • Stone composition analysis
  • Dietary and hydration counseling
  • Medication therapy when indicated
  • Long-term surveillance and imaging protocols

Our goal is to reduce recurrence risk and help patients avoid repeated ER visits, procedures, or long-term kidney complications.

Why Patients Trust RoMIUS Urology for Kidney Stone Care

  • Rapid access and coordinated care across multiple EDs
  • Immediate surgical availability when needed
  • Tailored treatment pathways with ongoing support
  • Regional leaders in ureteroscopy, ESWL, and PCNL
  • Comprehensive stent, pain, and symptom management
  • Complete metabolic evaluation and long-term prevention
  • A patient-centered approach focused on comfort and durable outcomes
